title: Ophamin: an empirical observatory wrapped around a substrate under test
description: Ophamin is an empirical observatory wrapped around a substrate under test. It is built for Kimera-SWM but independent of it: the substrate plugs in through one adapter and a MockSubstrate makes the framework runnable without Kimera. The architecture is six wheels in two concentric triads — an outer triad for empirical observation (seeing / measuring / comparing) and an inner triad for engineering observation (instrumenting / auditing / reporting) — plus cross-cutting layers for per-primitive inspection and standard-format interop (SARIF / JUnit XML / MLflow / CycloneDX SBOM). Nineteen scenarios across five experimentation tiers (scientific, engineering, philosophical, measurement-machinery, structural) produce signed 9-section Empirical Proof Records with pre-registered falsifiable claims. Every signed record is content-addressed and HMAC-signed; the schema versions are catalogued in SCHEMAS.md with explicit backward-compat policy.
